Chapter 6958: High Heaven Avatar’S Slash

Chapter 6958: High Heaven Avatar’s Slash

According to the legend, the slash cut down all combatants except Heavenfall and the mysterious leader. It also sliced through the trap and the battlefield, Heaven Pit.

The trap was meant specifically to kill the high heaven. Some believed an unimaginable item was buried here. It was one of a kind and went missing afterward. After all, none dared to get close to the slash.

There was no hope in Ruin, only destruction and fatal dangers looming in all corners. The only thing relatively intact was the shell of Heaven Pit.

Li Qiye stood among the tribulations, observing the slash and the damaged Heaven Pit. The latter was special, far superior to any forbidden ground.

He then noticed something on the outskirts of Heaven Pit - life. He immediately teleported through the disasters and appeared above this tiny world.

It was new, protected by the remnants of Heaven Pit, and was only the size of a continent in the nine worlds.

Nevertheless, Ruin was once a major world. Thus, the budding region had plenty of primordial chaos true energy.

“Cultivators still, how surprising.” Li Qiye scanned and murmured.

Two places grabbed his attention - a mountain range with a crater in the center. By now, trees and vegetation have taken over. Buildings could be seen as well.

The other spot had enough energy to form a faint image of a primordial tree. This was a great lineage built atop a mountain. At the base was a populous city.

“Interesting.” Li Qiye smiled and entered this tiny world.

Upon arrival, he felt its dao power. It resembled a Buddhist power but not the conversion type. It was more a state of mind, tranquil and calm in all situations. It was firm and transcending, originating from primordial chaos true energy.

“A bowing Buddha.” Li Qiye couldn’t help but smile.

This feeling painted the picture of a Buddha lowering his head and chanting softly. There was no need to worship him.

As Li Qiye walked through towns and villages, he found that the cultivators here called themselves laypeople.

They are simpler and less greedy than normal cultivators, not wishing to fight over resources. Their dao came from Myriad Buddhas Monastery, the strongest lineage in this world.

Its founder was Mundane Immortal. She passed down her dao so that living beings could survive amidst the destruction outside.
